title: A practical synthesis of enantiopure syn-β-amino-α-hydroxy acids from α-amino acids with application in the formal syntheses of L-TFB-TBOA and (S)-vigabatrin
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35635-35641
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05586E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bohua Long, Peng Zhang, Mengmeng Jiang, Pengfei Guo, Xuanluan Chen, Shunlei Shang, Zhengzhi Wu
Enantiopure syn-β-amino-α-hydroxy acids have been synthesized from α-amino acids in a multi-step procedure that exhibits a high level of stereoselectivity and good overall yields.
